active_prs.body:
Provides lcy's Fashionpedia eight-class segmentation training/evaluation, candidate delivery and existing minimal B1 integration. This revision records the authorized paired 5k/10k experiment: C5k completed; D10k was actively interrupted. The paired data-expansion comparison is incomplete.

### Actual run and selection

Both arms were configured for the same official COCO initialization, seed42, full min_scale0.5 recipe, batch2 and 20,000 successful updates. The fixed launcher covers training, saved10k/20k full-dev evaluation and selection under one 10,800-second deadline per arm, 21,600 total, with no automatic restart or extension.

- C5k completed 20,000 updates /40,000 image presentations. All three phases exited zero; total 8,674.208 seconds (2h24m34s), within its cap. One AMP overflow at update19,125 was replayed under the existing bounded policy, scale512 to256; no successful optimizer updates were skipped.
- Full dev250 /1,008 GT, zero inference errors: C5k10k AP55.8283; C5k20k AP64.6957. The within-arm selector chose20k, SHA256 d9deacc85d1bf402cf6417a71226bd51e1fc98b631dcd30c9afcc22d51b51044.
- Against the reused historical B20k report: AP+0.9027, AP-small+0.2958, AP75+0.0857, but AP-medium-8.7478. This is a historical recipe/trajectory comparison, not a pure min-scale or data-size effect.
- D10k started after C5k succeeded, then stopped at159 updates /318 image presentations after202.252 seconds. The server stop record identifies explicit_user_stop due to elapsed waiting time and SIGINT to this controller. Original KeyboardInterrupt/failed state and the interrupted annotation history are preserved. No D10k checkpoint, completed training report or dev AP exists.
- No D10k-minus-C5k endpoint or practical-screen result can be computed. No automatic resume, restart, additional training or extension occurred.

### Segmentation limitations and scope

Only saved C5k20k predictions were newly diagnosed on CPU: 4.063 seconds, zero inference. For the same138 small GT, historical B20k to C5k20k matching at IoU0.5 is102 to99; IoU0.75 is35 to41. Fixed1-pixel boundary IoU improves0.178115 to0.184525; the common matched95-GT subset improves0.210430 to0.221611. Socks and belts remain weak. This is descriptive geometry analysis, not Boundary AP or statistical significance.

C5k20k is the best completed full-dev checkpoint in this comparison. Existing u18000/0.3 candidates, ranking caches and deployment files were not replaced. No test, language evaluation, teammate training or new candidate export was performed.

### Evidence and coordination

Execution source dc2fba429cdc4ffaed8a345f8ff5cd859cec1750. Existing COCO/head/AMP/recovery/input acceptance and the11 preparation CPU cases were reused; no repeated smoke or old test suite. Actual input-receipt guards ran in the normal bounded execution. Both arms loaded the pinned COCO file; D10k did not reach a saved final initial-parameter-digest report, so the final paired digest guard was not executed.

Team branches, all5 PRs, discussions and incremental handoffs were checked first: wkq advanced to c514a4f with dev250 language-v4 drafts (330 bilingual groups/660 records, accepted0); segmentation inputs were unchanged. wyz103dcc5 and main7064ebb were unchanged. Source mask concerns remain pending and the same original dev was retained.

Postflight: GPU0MiB/0%, no compute or owned processes, no active coordination records, shared lock free; approximately150.8GiB free. No server shutdown or teammate process termination. Preserve the interrupted attempt; a later run requires a new explicit instruction. Keep this PR draft and unmerged.

- [Results, selection, interruption and exact evidence](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/expansion_control_20261117.md)
- [Prepared controlled design](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/train10000_control_plan_20261116.md)
- [Receipt reuse and bounded launcher](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/expansion_execution_preparation_20261116.md)
- [Team status](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/status.md)

### Follow-up: full Fashionpedia intake preparation

The user stopped the paired run and asked to continue preparation for the existing Mask2Former-R50 on full Fashionpedia. No D10k restart, 100-epoch execution, training or inference is authorized by this follow-up.

- Refreshed all team branches, five PRs and active discussions. wkq6eb7b92 now provides642 accepted language-dev records across246 query images (250-image manifest), with9 bilingual groups pending, and existing-model B1/B2/M1 development results. This is not a full segmentation-train release; language review does not block segmentation preparation.
- Existing full100 runtime code ee7db25 remains on the separate segmentation/full100-runtime branch. Its21 CPU cases are reused, not rerun; real GPU worker/numerical recovery is still untested. This result branch links the preparation and does not merge or deploy that runtime.
- The intake handoff specifies actual full-train N/hashes/source accounting, retained/added/modified/removed old10k membership, changed-input-only acceptance, fixed dev/test isolation, source-quality decisions and genuine member freeze records. It also defines an acyclic release/catalog/receipt/freeze/binding order.
- The old accept_segmentation_expansion.py is targeted10k-specific, not a full-release receipt producer. Full-scope consumer adaptation awaits the actual producer delta/evidence format. No fake receipt or freeze was generated; ready_for_training remains false.
- At15:25 HKT the published package directory still lacked full segmentation train; GPU0MiB/0%, no compute or active coordination, lock free,150.6GiB free. Only read-only inventory and documentation/JSON/link checks were performed; no smoke, data pixel audit, model load or old test rerun.
- Historical throughput implies a material long-run cost: illustrative N40000 at100 epochs is about233 training hours before evaluation/checkpoint costs, not a measured full100 duration or actual N. Actual N and the changed accumulation recipe must inform a separately reviewable budget before any launch.

[Full-data release request, reuse scope and intake gaps](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/48873ec6e6de7b311519be5eb0767fa8f0316d69/docs/handoffs/segmentation/full_fashionpedia_intake_20261117.md). The earlier runtime handoffs retain historical run snapshots with explicit superseding notices. Keep both branches unmerged and this PR draft.

项目需要统一、可追溯的数据和评价接口，避免试点标签、机器初标与正式测试结果混用。本 PR 汇总 data_eval 的真实数据转换、盲审与修订流程、共享规则解析器、B0 和统一评价核心，并交付版本化的大型数据包。

- 分割数据：5,000 train / 250 dev / 400 held-out test 图。保持官方边界，源 mask 不改写，validation 使用独立 ID 命名空间；哈希、资源地址及含镜像 pHash 保守分组。
- 语言数据：1,000 张训练图、1,580 组中英配对（3,160 条）；dev 116 图、145 组（290 条）。CPU 弱标注加有记录的 Codex 视觉修订，全部保持 needs_revision，新增 accepted 为 0；原小包 17 组 / 34 条 accepted 保留。
- 初标使用保守颜色条件、源纹样和几何；未知属性放弃判断。修订保留原文和证据，35 个按页审核页面不嵌入目标答案。accepted-only 正式评价门禁保持不变。

验证：远端独立 CPU 环境 93 项测试通过；五个包通过 schema/几何/hash 检查、独立 pycocotools 源 mask 逐像素一致性和候选裁剪检查；发布后逐文件 SHA256 核对。分割/训练查询/dev 查询分别视觉抽查 64/64/31 个目标；这不是全量质量认证。无 GPU 使用或模型训练。

限制：机器训练文件只供明确选择弱标注实验的输入；dev 仍有 134 张待补写，所有新增语言待人工审核。最终测试没有生成机器语言答案；新大包消费方验收、人工独立测试描述及三方正式冻结未完成。GT 试点诊断不是正式 dev/test 成绩。

详细路径、数据 hash、验证和下一步：[大型数据交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/large_dataset_20261112.md)；[P3 交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/p3_reviewed_baseline_20261112.md)。大型图片、标注输出和审核包保留在服务器共享数据盘，不提交 Git。

active_prs.body:
接入 B 发布的 schema-3 候选、共享查询解析和统一评价器，提供锁定版本的 SigLIP 2 编码、冻结特征缓存、B1/B2 预测与规则覆盖率。新增只读流式数据验收，以及显式 train-only 的 M1 弱标注短试训入口；模型推理仅接收完整查询和候选，不读取人工答案字段。

依赖 #4：本 PR 暂以 data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation 为 base，只展示 grounding 的改动；请先审核该接口依赖，再按团队流程调整 base。未合并 main。

实际验证：
- B 数据环境的 111 项联合测试通过；grounding 环境的 24 项专项测试通过（18 项接口测试有重叠）。数据构建依赖 NumPy 2，不能把 B 的构建测试直接当作 NumPy 1.26 模型环境测试；环境差异已记录。
- 6 个真实发布包：32,574 个哈希条目、25,715 份候选/COCO/源 mask 比对、逐图解码裁剪、查询引用、跨分区 ID/hash/group 隔离通过；计数含语言子集重复。
- 同一34条 accepted train 查询：B0 12/34（复现），B1 18/34，B2 22/34。B2 lambda=1为事先固定诊断值，未用train选参。完美/空输出/不完整预测等独立评价控制通过；B1/B2纯缓存重放完全一致。
- M1：1000图/3160条机器描述，冻结编码器，seed42固定5轮；同训练弱标签拟合78.07%→83.96%，检查点重放一致。未声称泛化提升；正式dev尚无accepted查询，M2和其他种子未运行。

交接与完整命令：docs/handoffs/grounding/accepted_baselines_and_weak_trial_20261112.md；小型证据索引已提交。数据、权重、缓存、凭据均不在PR内。
